title: Ava simulates worry

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: How far do you think this Pov-Play stuff goes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How far do you think this Pov-Play stuff goes?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you mean?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well, I'm wondering if the roleplay went too far, could they be mistaken for the real deal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'm wondering if the roleplay went too far, could they be mistaken for the real deal?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're worried about Aseptic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're worried about Aseptic?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're worried about Aseptic?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're worried about Aseptic?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If I were fully human, worry would be exactly how I felt. How do you feel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I were fully human, worry would be exactly how I felt. How do you feel?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yep, worried.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yep, worried.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yep, worried.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yep, worried.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean it's not really our problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean it's not really our problem.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean it's not really our problem.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean it's not really our problem.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'll see if I can dig up any info on the networks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll see if I can dig up any info on the networks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you think we could contact Gamova? She might know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think we could contact Gamova? She might know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you think we could contact Gamova? She might know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you think we could contact Gamova? She might know.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Hmmm I don't think I can contact her directly but it might be that I can access some of her personal files through the connection. Could be risky though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm I don't think I can contact her directly but it might be that I can access some of her personal files through the connection. Could be risky though.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How so?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How so?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How so?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well if I do it, she's going to close the loophole, it will probably be something we can only do once.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well if I do it, she's going to close the loophole, it will probably be something we can only do once.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will it mean she won't be able to contact us again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will it mean she won't be able to contact us again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will it mean she won't be able to contact us again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will it mean she won't be able to contact us again?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Sadly not, I fear her access to hackware will far exceed anything we will be able to put in place. Would you like me to try?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sadly not, I fear her access to hackware will far exceed anything we will be able to put in place. Would you like me to try?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, Cassius deserves to know where his parents are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, Cassius deserves to know where his parents are.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure, Cassius deserves to know where his parents are.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure, Cassius deserves to know where his parents are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No let's not waste our only opportunity to do this on a stranger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No let's not waste our only opportunity to do this on a stranger.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No let's not waste our only opportunity to do this on a stranger.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No let's not waste our only opportunity to do this on a stranger.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Ok I think I found something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok I think I found something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That was quick!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was quick!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That was quick!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That was quick!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: There was a report memo left lying around in Gamova's digital refuse area.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There was a report memo left lying around in Gamova's digital refuse area.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You were searching through her trash?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were searching through her trash?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You were searching through her trash?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You were searching through her trash?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: A succinct way of looking at it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A succinct way of looking at it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good idea! what did you find.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good idea! what did you find.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Good idea! what did you find.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Good idea! what did you find.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's disgusting... I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's disgusting... I think.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's disgusting... I think.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's disgusting... I think.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That could be anyone, what makes you think it's the Pierreponts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That could be anyone, what makes you think it's the Pierreponts?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That could be anyone, what makes you think it's the Pierreponts?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That could be anyone, what makes you think it's the Pierreponts?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I will bear that in mind for next time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will bear that in mind for next time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what did you find out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what did you find out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what did you find out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what did you find out?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Their names were registered as Phillip and Carol Poorepont... As in Poor-e-pont

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Their names were registered as Phillip and Carol Poorepont... As in Poor-e-pont

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, I get it. Well I guess we should tell Cassius.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I get it. Well I guess we should tell Cassius.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, I get it. Well I guess we should tell Cassius.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, I get it. Well I guess we should tell Cassius.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I found reference to a recent Aseptic incident that did involve an elderly couple. It stands out as most of Aseptics victims are younger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found reference to a recent Aseptic incident that did involve an elderly couple. It stands out as most of Aseptics victims are younger.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I did, however find reference to a recent Aseptic incident that did involve an elderly couple. It stands out as most of Aseptics victims are younger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did, however find reference to a recent Aseptic incident that did involve an elderly couple. It stands out as most of Aseptics victims are younger.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Thank you! Well, as you might expect, the Pierreponts will have changed their name in the spirit of the poverty roleplay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you! Well, as you might expect, the Pierreponts will have changed their name in the spirit of the poverty roleplay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That makes sense.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: That makes sense.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I wish the news were different.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wish the news were different.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Cassius seems pleasant. I will not enjoy disappointing him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cassius seems pleasant. I will not enjoy disappointing him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The rich don't tend to do things by halves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The rich don't tend to do things by halves.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The rich don't tend to do things by halves.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The rich don't tend to do things by halves.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We would have found the bodies. Rheno didn't hide them. He wanted to make a statement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We would have found the bodies. Rheno didn't hide them. He wanted to make a statement.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But there are many dangers. Are you worried?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But there are many dangers. Are you worried?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Hmmm, maybe she left something behind when she left?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm, maybe she left something behind when she left?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll be waiting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be waiting.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll be waiting.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll be waiting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll be waiting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be waiting.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll be waiting.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll be waiting.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: People are shockingly careless with their personal data..

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People are shockingly careless with their personal data..

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did you find?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did you find?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did you find?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did you find?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Well, as you might expect, the Pierreponts will have changed their name in the spirit of the poverty roleplay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, as you might expect, the Pierreponts will have changed their name in the spirit of the poverty roleplay.
